gauge.name: Buffalo Creek near Haigler

impacts.statement: A farm residence is about a quarter mile south of the gauge site. When the creek starts to flood, it will start to impact the eastern end of the farmstead. However, the creek would have to spread an eighth to a quarter mile to reach the residence.

dataAttribution.text: USGS--Water Resources of the United States

Observations courtesy of U.S. Geological Survey

hydronotes.statement: The current flows in cubic feet per second, are approximate and may be affected by debris, aquatic growth, and seasonal ice in the river.

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are not available. Only observed stages are available for this point.
